This correction was made on PR1C Rev.6, the revision Lane B verified. meoclass1/QB1_F.html independently cites PR1C Rev.7 as applicable from 1 January 2026, and states the SAME A.1/A.2 distinction, the SAME six-month withdrawal rule and the SAME 'certain statutory certificates' wording. The card now carries that caveat in its version stamp. Neither revision is asserted as current here. Recommend Lane B resolve which revision governs and whether the A/B clause numbering is stable across Rev.6 to Rev.7.
